## Checklist

- [ ] It does one thing, and is small enough to review.
- [ ] It has tests for what it changes, and no tests were removed or switched off.
- [ ] I ran `pytest tests/` and everything passes.
- [ ] It works with a screen reader and a keyboard, if it changes anything people see or hear.
- [ ] It passes the granny test: someone who's never used an AI agent could still use it.
- [ ] It's economical: it doesn't add much to what's sent to the AI model with every message.
